Rediscover rubber and road.
Introducing the all-new 2022 BRZ.
Driving should feel like driving. It’s a simple, undeniable idea that gets right at the heart of the
all-new BRZ, a hyper-focused, thrillingly pure sports car—now with more power, more torque and
quicker acceleration. You’re the driver, and the BRZ won’t let you forget it.
This BRZ is all-new, but it’s still rooted in the classics—a front-engine,
rear-wheel drive layout paired with a six-speed manual transmission. You
Pure can also opt for the redesigned six-speed automatic with paddle shifters
Sports Car and rev matching to get that feeling of control from shifting.

2.4-liter SUBARU BOXER® engine with 228 hp and 184 lb-ft of torque,
now delivered sooner and across a wider rev range. That bump in power
is in your control, thanks to a stiffened chassis, track-tested suspension,
